title.Title: Power: 12 V in, 5.6 V buck, two low-noise 5 V LNA rails, noise-source rail, 3.3 V

texts.text: Power: 12 V in, 5.6 V buck, two low-noise 5 V LNA rails, noise-source rail, 3.3 V
Band build: uhf = 470-821 MHz (DVB-T, LTE B20/B28, 5G n28). CAL_EN (1.8-3.3 V logic): high = noise source on, all switches on OUTPUT2.
Noise into every channel: ENR ~39 dB at UHF, falling with SPF5043Z gain to ~15 dB at 3.5 GHz.
RF traces: 50 ohm grounded coplanar waveguide on L1 over solid GND on L2. Keep the chain in line.
